foundation.title: Brand foundations
foundation.body: Woodcraft, furniture and everyday life frame this retrospective design study. The material does not establish an official commission.

material.title: A material system
material.body: Wood, surface, joints and edges organise the material language. Species, finishes and durability require samples and engineering validation.

space.title: Void and layers
space.body: Spacing, layers, movement and light connect objects with their photographic representation. These images are design studies.

summer.title: Summer: props connect the merchandise
summer.body: Fishing rods, hands and folding chairs create a viewing path. Compare product position, prop scale and background contrast so the narrative keeps merchandise legible.
captions: Summer window with a fishing rod, folding chair, fish props and a speech bubble
Summer window with a mannequin, drink-shaped prop, orange slice and COOL speech bubble

autumn.title: Autumn: familiar frames, unfamiliar scale
autumn.body: Doors, windows and walls establish spatial references. Oversized animals disrupt those references while framing and suspension separate merchandise from large props.
captions: Autumn window with an oversized pink fish passing through a doorway beside a mannequin
Autumn window with a yellow snail, an open door and a suspended pink bag

winter.title: Winter: different rhythms for different windows
winter.body: Wide windows connect products across snow planes. Tall windows build a vertical hierarchy around the horse. Each format requires a new composition.
captions: Wide winter window with a large white horse head, snowy planes, a yellow bag and a small pink horse
Layered white horse contours and suspended accessories against a blue background

delivery.title: From visual direction to spatial relationships
delivery.body: My contribution was 3D design and visual presentation within BENWU. The retrospective diagram compares composition and merchandise hierarchy; individual production and store-delivery responsibility is not established.
captions: From visual direction to spatial relationships

layers.title: Terrain, body and equipment
layers.body: A rock face anchors the background, layered contours form the middle ground and a mannequin establishes human scale. Their boundaries and overlap help equipment remain readable.
captions: Arc’teryx Mountain Performance Field | user-supplied retrospective board 01 / 10
Arc’teryx Alpha Center window with rock forms, layered curves and a mannequin holding poles

coordination.title: Communicate spatial relationships
coordination.body: Compare the rock face, curves and equipment as distinct layers. Window format, lighting and product visibility guide the spatial reading.

installation.title: The window in its retail context
installation.body: Additional installation views connect the window with the interior. Rock, directional lines, mannequins and moss surfaces extend the mountain language around clothing and circulation.
captions: Arc’teryx Alpha Center installation, front window

home.title: Understand the service, then take action
home.body: The VI/UI connects brand expression with service entry points. The homepage introduces the offer before presenting the main action.

models.title: Support browsing and deliberate search
models.body: Model lists and name search support two different tasks. Hierarchy helps users identify a model, understand its entry point and continue.

mobile.title: Preserve the main action on mobile
mobile.body: I designed and iterated the VI/UI. The mobile study rearranges content by priority, checking text, actions and scrolling. This archive does not establish ownership of the deployed service.

interface.title: One identity across desktop and mobile
interface.body: Desktop and mobile views share naming and brand rules. The smaller screen rearranges information around the primary action.

exploration.title: Build the system around recognition
exploration.body: Compare the photography-equipment context, name recognition and small-scale legibility. The wordmark anchors the visual and information system.
captions: Design decisions and system applications (Chinese diagram)

wordmark.title: Compare the wordmark at different scales
wordmark.body: The PERIASTRA wordmark study, dated 9 June 2026, supports comparison of letterforms, hierarchy and application scale. Commercial adoption is not independently verified.

identity.title: From historical exploration to a private seal
identity.body: The earlier Songnasty exploration and current YELISI mark show a shift in identity language. Seal, folded line and cut-corner forms connect naming, graphics and product context.

product.title: Connect identity, products and CMF
product.body: Collaborative brand and product-concept work shares a material direction. The archive supports comparison of form and surface; no manufacture or market launch is claimed.
captions: Design decisions and system applications (Chinese diagram)

family.title: A shared section across different uses
family.body: Table and floor lights share a linear body, luminous strips and distinctive ends. Support, length and direction change around the use scenario.
captions: Silver table lamp with a circular base beside an open book on a blue surface
Full view of a silver floor lamp against black

materials.title: Separate material and functional cues
materials.body: Metal channels, luminous surfaces and circular controls explain different roles. Renderings support comparison of reflection and proportion; optical performance requires testing.
captions: Detail of a gold light body with longitudinal light strips and a circular control
Horizontal pendant with parallel light strips, metal channels and end details against a dark background

space.title: Check the object against the room
space.body: Wall recesses and long tables provide scale references. Scenes help compare length, mounting and visual centre in an actual use context.
captions: Gold vertical wall light within a grey architectural recess
Horizontal linear pendant above a dining table and chairs

study.title: Turn a child’s use into form constraints
study.body: Sketches and physical models explore grip, mouthpiece position and approachability. Clinical performance and manufacture remain outside the validated scope.
captions: Sketches, handmade form models and AIGC exploration

parts.title: Separate contact, grip and charging
parts.body: Mouth contact, handheld volume and charging base have different requirements. Their separation makes the relationship between position and action available for review.

system.title: Connect the product and its feedback
system.body: The device and base form a use unit. Interface feedback addresses children, carers and clinicians. Models and renderings document the concept stage.
captions: Proposed breath interaction and feedback sequence

journey.title: From travel preparation to maintenance
journey.body: Carrying, changing modules, cleaning and storage create different tasks. The journey gives the product system concrete design criteria.

modules.title: Organise the system around use
modules.body: The handle, replaceable modules and supporting information respond to carrying, switching, cleaning and storage. The diagram analyses original concept evidence.

interface.title: Connect the object and its instructions
interface.body: The companion interface organises care guidance and module recognition. Naming, colour and hierarchy remain consistent across the product and instructions.

service.title: Define the roles before the equipment
service.body: The service blueprint separates public participation, professional operation and equipment maintenance. Permissions and information flows frame the scanning, transport and return tasks.

assembly.title: Explain the robot through its parts
assembly.body: Overall and exploded views connect the body, actuators and tail. This concept does not establish sealing, power or pipe-traversal performance.

workflow.title: Connect equipment and interface
workflow.body: The station, device and control interface support parking, execution and monitoring. Their relationship makes it possible to review entry, feedback and recovery.

review.title: Make automated rewriting reviewable
review.body: Before-and-after differences let the user choose which changes to keep. Confirmation and undo preserve control over the text.
captions: Reviewing an AI rewrite diff in Resume Formatter

versions.title: Give the master and variants distinct roles
versions.body: The master retains stable facts; role-specific versions choose emphasis. Evidence links keep wording close to its supporting record.
captions: Master resume, job version and evidence workspace

layout.title: Make layout changes visible and reversible
layout.body: Templates change presentation rather than silently changing facts. This tool builds on an MIT upstream fork; this portfolio’s independent Word-export pipeline is not a feature claim about that editor.
captions: Resume Formatter template and layout controls

desktop.title: Keep spatial input and feedback together
desktop.body: Objects, parameters and views share one editor. Drawing, selection and constraints help users understand the next action.

mobile.title: Preserve the spatial task on a small screen
mobile.body: Mobile reallocates attention between tools and canvas. X-Ray exposes internal relationships while retaining an explicit way back.

onboarding.title: Make the income model understandable
onboarding.body: A clear first-run configuration connects home-screen values to user inputs. Native WeChat developer-tool captures document this interface.

detail.title: Let users inspect the number
detail.body: The detail view explains a result; the calendar handles days without records. Empty states are part of the workflow.
captions: Xintiao calendar with no completed records

settings.title: Let users control appearance and motion
settings.body: Themes and motion controls accommodate preferences. The native mini-program reuses PayDance’s AGPL-3.0-only calculation core, credited separately from interface work.

guide.title: Establish input context before the task
guide.body: Guidance and sample material provide a starting point. Material, task and result share a workspace that supports stepwise progress and recovery.

analysis.title: Reuse structured material analysis
analysis.body: Structured output helps analysis feed later tasks. This public demonstration uses precomputed results and does not claim live model inference.
captions: Lensflow image analysis and structured results

control.title: A controllable creative workflow
control.body: A film-language reference, a new story and two character inputs become a storyboard, Blender blocking, controlled imagery and prompts, then a Seedance 2.5 render. The 11 storyboard units and 20+ characters are my process-log counts.
captions: Workflow map from case observation to a reviewed output
A Blender blocking frame from the supplied source video used to check camera and cast relations

evaluation.title: Review relationships, then revise the right layer
evaluation.body: A searchable reference index, six control layers and eight analyses connect product, CMF, space and narrative. The personal 22.08-second film remains a process record; upstream retests are not personal results. Explore Systems / AI video methods on the website.
captions: Six control layers for an AI video workflow
Review relationships, then revise the right layer
